note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation, with a third West Ward seat vacant through the death of Michael M'Menamin; nominations Friday 5 January 1934. All eleven nominees, five Nationalists and six Unionists, were returned unopposed and there was no poll (Derry Journal, 8 January 1934). No party labels are printed against the names. Maxwell, a solicitor and son of the late Alderman Patrick Maxwell, replaced F. C. Towers. Returned unopposed.
